reuse.rule: Reuse actual r21 fixes and original physical/observation/reward/PPO/formal-task settings. Do not inherit R11 paused-run paths/status,48h autonomous campaign,6-stream wait or mandatory formal-freeze gate for early engineering sampling.

execution.clock_starts: first activity on the assigned task, including reading
execution.stop_when: assigned goal complete, concrete unresolved blocker, or4h deadline
execution.unfinished_task_rule: Keep actual work and counts; the next user-started window continues the same task when needed, without a new planning cycle.
default_reads: current handoff and task row in docs/TERRAIN_MEMORY_PLAN.md

tasks.goal: Port necessary paths/build/assets to5080 and actually run r21 materialE30.
tasks.done: One real E30 record. Repair ordinary build/runtime errors directly; report partial only at deadline or a concrete blocker that cannot be resolved with available access/resources. E30 success is not required to prove migration.

tasks.goal: RAW seed0 actual first PPO update on the existing interactive candidate.
tasks.done: One real update, or saved actual samples/tail and a precise continuation at deadline.

tasks.goal: Connect frozen causal PANN to actual sampling and first PPO update.
tasks.done: One real update, or saved actual samples/tail and a precise continuation at deadline.

tasks.goal: One evidence-backed support-handoff correction, with directly relevant realE30.
tasks.done: Actual result and earliest remaining mismatch; no parameter matrix.

tasks.goal: Same-version qualifiedE30 then original materialE60; reuse existing same-version prerequisite.
tasks.done: Actual complete mission or recorded concrete failure, not extra audit tasks.

tasks.goal: Normal PPO learning in affordable window-sized increments and throughput evidence for cloud decision.
tasks.done: Actual new samples/updates,normal checkpoint and specific resource/remaining-work conclusion.

resources.workers: Choose from actual resources; preserve the setting of a formal qualification case. Lower concurrency when necessary.
resources.environment_changes: Only necessary task changes in kaiwen-learn; do not alter base/other environments/system libraries/global shell configuration.

learning.candidate_requires: Correct initial stand, effective permitted actions, real TM02 loading and original causal/physical failure semantics.
learning.active_streams: Only the stream assigned to this window; independent logs/checkpoints per group and actual controller version.
learning.pann: Keep frozen B ideal and causal2ms observer; no true q/e input.
learning.explicit_task_end_rule: If first256 or wall deadline is the declared end, mark external truncation before inserting the real final transition into buffer/GAE/update. True physical terminal has priority. Use actual pre-reset observation and do not add a failure/timeout bonus or penalty.
learning.unfinished_buffer_rule: Save valid tail,optimizer,RNG,normalization and counts during ordinary shutdown. Continue in a later actual training window; do not require a separate recovery exercise.
learning.incomplete_environment_snapshot_rule: Start a new physical session if full environment state was not saved. Record real boundaries and do not claim uninterrupted physics or fabricate missing successors.
learning.evidence: Use normal update logs,real trajectories and saved checkpoint. Do not replace real learning by mock tests or inflate results into convergence/benefit claims.

support_candidate_if_evidence_still_appl.interpretation: Single hypothesis; reference speed scale preserved,clearance reduced and acceleration increased. Check actual support,not only nominal gait.

control_and_evaluation.additional_run_rule: Only when it directly answers the current concrete failure/change; no unrelated matrix.
control_and_evaluation.formal_mission_wall_rule: Use actual cost to schedule within the current4h window. Do not automatically start an over-budget long mission or stitch interrupted portions into success.

process.hash_use: Existing automatic fields may remain; investigate a specific corruption/wrong-file problem only when evidence requires it. No new routine certification stage.

outputs.handoff: Update only the six current-handoff lines in docs/TERRAIN_MEMORY_PLAN.md plus necessary normal run results.
outputs.publication: Commit/push source and compact results. Upload large checkpoints needed for continuation directly from execution host to Release; record ordinary push success and commit. No separate exhaustive audit.
outputs.unfinished_upload: At deadline record exact output location and remaining upload; continue next window without regenerating all artifacts.
